tier_should.rationale: Strong RCT follow-ups show durable mental-health gains and belief-updating mechanisms; credible design, cost-effectiveness, expert-elicitation contrast. Limited economic outcome effects constrain general-interest appeal but fit top field outlets well.

tier_will.rationale: Prominent authors, rigorous methods, policy relevance, and novel mechanisms make top-field publication likely; absence of economic gains may preclude top-five general, steering toward AEJ Applied/EJ/Restud-Field equivalents.
